segments.text: Member of a family with a good lineage, a cousin of Enshou.
袁紹の従妹にして、荊州の太守。
実は袁紹の事を嫌っており、ことあるごとに陰謀を巡らせ陥れようとするが、袁紹の超絶幸運にいつも失敗している。
呉に負けて追放され、大陸各地を彷徨っていた麗羽の従妹。
今作では物語序盤、空腹で倒れているところを北郷隊に拾われ、一刀の庇護を受けることとなる。
命を救われたことで一刀に恩義を感じ、真名を許すと共に、一刀のことを主様 （ぬしさま） と呼んで慕うようになる。
お友達は美以＋三猫たち。
大陸各地を彷徨う零落の蜂蜜姫。
お嬢様育ちのせいで我侭で少し足りない。
従姉の袁紹とは非常に折り合いが悪い。
魏の領地で何か画策しているようだが…
初次登场于《恋姬无双》系列第二季，是个任性傲娇的萝莉公主，跟她的姐姐丽羽一样，对于治理领地方面也是很无能，曾因这一点而被爱纱吐槽，发型也跟丽羽很像，自称在姐姐面前完全变得没有气势，喜欢在被别人夸奖后说“是啊是啊，继续夸我吧”。对唱歌很有天赋，喜欢唱歌后喝蜂蜜水。
Oldest son of an equestrian tribe from the state of Ryou.
猪突猛進。敵と見れば真っ直ぐ突進、罠があっても力づくで打ち砕く！
元気一杯な女の子だが、元気一杯すぎてそそっかしいドジッコ女の子。エッチに関してはウブ。
軍の幹部のはずだが、自分の舞台は西涼からの子飼いのため、案外暇そうにしている翠。
相変わらず鈴々とつるみながら、ワイワイキャッキャッと日々を過ごしている。
失禁馬超の名に恥じぬお漏らしっぷりが、今作にはあるのかっ!?
馬三姉妹の長女。
五虎将のひとりで、軍の幹部のはずだが、平和が訪れたこの頃は案外暇そう。
字孟起（もうき）。
猪突猛进，一旦看见敌人就会一股劲往前冲，就算前面是陷阱也会凭借着蛮力将其粉碎！
是个精神十足的女孩，不过因为精神十足过头，同时也是个马大哈的冒失少女。
行动先于思考的类型，暴走机车。可是关于H则是懵懂的很，比常人还要害羞。
虽然属于体育会系，其实是最有少女风范的女孩也说不定。
A girl of the Maozoku.

However, she is not a full cat, but a mixed blood born between a human and a cat. It is very rare for a human and a cat to have a child. She never knew her parents and grew up with Ryuu Bi and Chou Hi as brothers ever since she can remember. She is straightforward and courteous, and her exceptional military prowess makes her a trusted member of the clan. However, Kan'U herself feels very much inferior because she is not a full-fledged cat, and she is often afraid of being left alone because of her parents' abandonment. Therefore, she tends to work too hard for her family and for Ryuu Bi.
translated from fammysgogo
Chief of the Maozoku.
His family has been revered by the villagers for generations.
He is a bit overprotective of Kan'u.
He's under the "Kin Mei" curse since he was born, which made him unable to grow up neither physically nor mentally but...
A Maozoku youth who was raised together with Kan'u and Ryuubi.
He admires Kan'u for being so strong and smart and is always working hard to be recognized by her.
A military commander who isn't a slave to the ordinary, he lives his life honestly by his own instincts and beliefs.
A military commander who distinguished himself at a young age.
He holds an ambition to conquer the continent.
A loyalist from Sou Sou's inner circle who serves him at the risk of his own life.

A hard-headed elite general. He is bound by social norms and stereotypes, and hates Maozoku and women. He is absolutely loyal to Sou Sou and only thinks about what is in his best interest. He is always with his cousin Kakou En. Through their battles to date, he has come to recognize Kan'U a little as a warrior, but he is by no means open-minded. He is still prejudiced against the thirteen tribes, and he is not amused that Sou Sou still desires the power of the Juuza.
"I wonder why. Your crying face tightens up my chest."
translated from fammysgogo
He serves the strongest commander Lu Bu. He acts as a butler as well as a military commander.
He has a soft manner and always seems to be smiling, but if Lu Bu orders it he will cut down any opponent without thinking twice.
Kakouton's cousin. Ever since he was young he would follow Kakouton whatever he did. They are currently serving under Sousou together.
One of Ryuubi's helpers. He has a lot of knowledge about human society and is well versed in social etiquette.
He acts as a foster parent to Kan'u as well as a teacher of the martial arts.
An optimistic Maozoku youth who is filled with curiosity.
He's always getting scolded by Chousosou.
A Maozoku youth, Chouseihei's nephew.
Leader of the Yellow Turbans.
Her outward appearance is of a voluptuous woman, however she is the strongest commander who wields superhuman strength.
A pervert who is excited by murdering and tormenting people.
She loves women and is never without her lover Chousen by her side.
She's interested in Kan'u.
Lu Bu's lover, she blindly trusts Lu Bu and worships her.
She's hostile toward Kan'u because Lu Bu is interested in her.
A government official who has been sent from the capital to help the fight against the Yellow Turbans. A high official in the Imperial court and a general of the government forces.
A noble who is highly valued by the emperor.
A general in Enshou's army.
He is sworn brothers with Ganryou.
A general in Enshou's army. He acts as Enshou's right hand man.
He is sworn brothers with Bunshuu.
Governer general of the state of Yu.
